INSERT INTO tools.uses (wire_tool_use_id, request_id, ord, tool_name, input, session_id,
                                 created_at)
         SELECT 'tu-page-' || n, $1, n, 'Read', '{}'::jsonb, $2,
                now() - make_interval(mins => 10 - n)
           FROM generate_series(1, 5) AS g(n)
